description: Municipal grants for rooftop solar, home batteries and plug-in solar (Balkonkraftwerk) for a postcode anywhere in Oberbayern (Upper Bavaria, all 500 municipalities from Ingolstadt to Berchtesgaden): amounts, guideline link and date, how to apply and when work may start. With a planned system (plan) it also estimates the grant. Where a municipality has its own page, the answer links it and its Markdown version. Without guarantee.

locale.description: Language of the answer: de (German) or en (English).

batteryKwh.description: Planned home battery in kWh (usable capacity)

pluginStorage.description: The plug-in solar system has its own battery

roofCostEur.description: Cost of the rooftop system from the quote, euros (only needed where the grant is a share of the cost)

roofKwp.description: Planned rooftop solar system in kWp

wallbox.description: A wallbox is installed at the same time
